name: Somchai Watanapan
bio:
Somchai Watanapan's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for tinkering with engines in his father's small automotive shop in Bangkok. After graduating with a degree in Mechanical Engineering from Chulalongkorn University, he honed his skills at a local racing team, steadily climbing the ranks. His meticulous approach to data analysis and his ability to translate complex technical information into actionable strategies quickly made him a valuable asset. 

Somchai is known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his commitment to fostering a collaborative environment within the team. He believes in empowering his mechanics and drivers to voice their concerns and ideas, fostering a culture of shared responsibility. His ability to anticipate potential mechanical issues and proactively address them has earned him a reputation for reliability and efficiency. He joined Tolman Motorsport three seasons ago and feels he is ready to take the team to the next level.

What sets Somchai apart is his intuitive understanding of vehicle dynamics and his uncanny ability to diagnose problems remotely, often suggesting solutions based solely on telemetry data. He has a talent for optimizing car setup for varying track conditions, squeezing every last drop of performance out of the machine.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave on the left side
physical.description: Somchai is of average height with a wiry build, and always wears a slight smile.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten notes and calculations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on starting every race day with a traditional Thai amulet blessing for good luck.
